Primary Variable Action: Roof Live / Snow / Rain (Lr/S/R) with L
Roof Live / Snow / Rain (Lr/S/R) with W

Design Method: [a] The load factor on L in combinations 3, 4, and 6 is permitted to equal 0.5 for all occupancies in which L0 in Chapter 4, Table 4.3-1, is less than or equal to 100 psf, with the exception of garages or areas occupied as places of public assembly.
[b] Where the effect of E is derived from nonstructural component seismic force Fp (ASCE 7-22 Section 13.3.1), replace rho*QE with Fp, where Ev = +/- 0.2*SDS*Wp.
[c] Where the seismic load effect with overstrength Em is required for nonstructural anchorage (ASCE 7-22 Section 13.4.2), replace Omega_0*QE with Omega_0p*Fp.
[d] In Combinations 7 and 10 (ASD), the vertical seismic load effect Ev is permitted to be taken as zero where SDS <= 0.125.
